title: Short exact Cech comparison diagram for external cup in the right coefficient
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $X,Y$ quasi-compact $k$-schemes with affine diagonals [def-pc-scheme], $F$ a quasi-coherent module on $X$ [pqf-def-coherent], and $S$ a short exact sequence of quasi-coherent modules on $Y$ [def-sp-abelian]. There exist three normalized external-cup cochain maps $d_r$ for $(F,S.X_r)$ [lem-sc-picard-external-cup-cochain], two short exact sequences $T,U$ of integer cochain complexes of $k$-modules, and a morphism $\psi:T\to U$. For every natural degree $n$ and each $r=1,2,3$, there are isomorphisms $a_r(n):H^n(T.X_r)\cong H^n(\operatorname{picardExternalTotal}(F,S.X_r))$ and $b_r(n):H^n(U.X_r)\cong H^n(\operatorname{picardScalarModel}(F\boxtimes S.X_r))$ [lem-sc-picard-kunneth-resolution-model] such that $H^n(\psi.\tau_r)=a_r(n)\circ H^n(d_r)\circ b_r(n)^{-1}$ (composition in the order written). In every negative degree the homologies of the second and third terms of both sequences are zero. No exact homology row or invertibility of any comparison is asserted.

source.place: Tag 0BED, lemma-kunneth, short exact sequence paragraph following equation 33.29.1.1 and the same argument in the right coefficient

proof.text: Choose finite subcovers of the affine covers of X and Y. The fixed tensor and product Cech functors give T and U. The exactness theorem gives their short exactness; the independent cup comparison theorem provides the normalized d_r, the diagram morphism and its scalar-model homology isomorphisms. In negative degrees every fixed complex is an extension by zero, so its terms are zero; isZero_homology_of_isZero_X₂ gives the four required vanishings. Assemble the existential witnesses and conjunctions without changing any signature.

theorem picardExternalCup_right_cech_diagram
    (k : Type w) [Field k] (X Y : Scheme.{w})
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    [CompactSpace X] [CompactSpace Y]
    [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal f)] [IsAffineHom (pullback.diagonal g)]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (S : ShortComplex Y.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    [S.X₁.IsQuasicoherent] [S.X₂.IsQuasicoherent] [S.X₃.IsQuasicoherent]
    :
    ∃ (d1 : picardExternalTotal f g F S.X₁ ⟶
      picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
        (externalCupCoefficients f g F S.X₁)),
    ∃ (d2 : picardExternalTotal f g F S.X₂ ⟶
      picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
        (externalCupCoefficients f g F S.X₂)),
    ∃ (d3 : picardExternalTotal f g F S.X₃ ⟶
      picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
        (externalCupCoefficients f g F S.X₃)),
    ∃ (T U : ShortComplex (CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{w} k) ℤ)) (ψ : T ⟶ U)
      (a1 : ∀ n : ℕ, T.X₁.homology (n : ℤ) ≅
        (picardExternalTotal f g F S.X₁).homology (n : ℤ))
      (b1 : ∀ n : ℕ, U.X₁.homology (n : ℤ) ≅
        (picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
          (externalCupCoefficients f g F S.X₁)).homology (n : ℤ))
      (a2 : ∀ n : ℕ, T.X₂.homology (n : ℤ) ≅
        (picardExternalTotal f g F S.X₂).homology (n : ℤ))
      (b2 : ∀ n : ℕ, U.X₂.homology (n : ℤ) ≅
        (picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
          (externalCupCoefficients f g F S.X₂)).homology (n : ℤ))
      (a3 : ∀ n : ℕ, T.X₃.homology (n : ℤ) ≅
        (picardExternalTotal f g F S.X₃).homology (n : ℤ))
      (b3 : ∀ n : ℕ, U.X₃.homology (n : ℤ) ≅
        (picardScalarModel (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
          (externalCupCoefficients f g F S.X₃)).homology (n : ℤ)),
      IsPicardExternalCupCochain f g F S.X₁ d1 ∧
      IsPicardExternalCupCochain f g F S.X₂ d2 ∧
      IsPicardExternalCupCochain f g F S.X₃ d3 ∧
      T.ShortExact ∧ U.ShortExact ∧
      (∀ i : ℤ, i < 0 → IsZero (T.X₂.homology i) ∧ IsZero (T.X₃.homology i) ∧
        IsZero (U.X₂.homology i) ∧ IsZero (U.X₃.homology i)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, HomologicalComplex.homologyMap ψ.τ₁ (n : ℤ) =
        (a1 n).hom ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap d1 (n : ℤ) ≫ (b1 n).inv) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, HomologicalComplex.homologyMap ψ.τ₂ (n : ℤ) =
        (a2 n).hom ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap d2 (n : ℤ) ≫ (b2 n).inv) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, HomologicalComplex.homologyMap ψ.τ₃ (n : ℤ) =
        (a3 n).hom ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap d3 (n : ℤ) ≫ (b3 n).inv)
